case_title: SOKOLOVA, YULIYA DBA VALENCIA AUTO VS DOCTOR PLUMBER, INC. et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY SOKOLOVA, YULIYA DBA VALENCIA AUTO AS TO DEFENDANT DOCTOR PLUMBER, INC. FULLER, ROSS FULLER, BRIAN KAUPOOKAMOKU, PAUL III ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-13-2006 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT FULLER, ROSS

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SOKOLOVA, YULIYA DBA VALENCIA AUTO RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT DOCTOR PLUMBER, INC. FULLER, ROSS FULLER, BRIAN KAUPOOKAMOKU, PAUL III $901.35 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $951.35, THE COURT DETERMINES PLAINTIFF'S DAMAGES TO BE $3901.35; DEFENDANT DOCTOR PLUMBER IS ENTITLED TO CREDIT FOR $3000 PREVIOUSLY PAID. THE JUDGMENT IS A NET AWARD. DEFENDANT'S BRIAN FULLER, KAUPOOKAMOU PAUL, ROSS, FULLER AND GRIMES DURHAM ARE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE, IN THAT THE JUDGMENT IS THE LIABILITY OF THE CORPORATION DOCTOR PLUMBER, INC.
